name: The Commons at Holmdel
summary: The Commons at Holmdel is a community shopping center on Route 35 in Holmdel, New Jersey, managed by Kimco Realty. With a 4.4-star rating from over 1,300 reviews, it serves as a convenient retail destination for Monmouth County residents.
demographics: The Commons at Holmdel serves an affluent suburban demographic in Monmouth County, New Jersey, with visitors primarily consisting of middle to upper-middle income families and professionals. The trade area attracts residents from Holmdel and surrounding communities like Middletown and Colts Neck, areas known for high household incomes, excellent schools, and family-oriented lifestyles. Typical shoppers include dual-income households aged 35-65 with children, seeking convenient access to everyday retail and dining options. The center benefits from its location along Route 35, a major commercial corridor that draws both local residents and commuters looking for accessible shopping experiences.
description: The Commons at Holmdel is a well-established community shopping center located at 2130 New Jersey Route 35 in Holmdel, New Jersey. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, this property serves as a convenient retail destination for residents of Monmouth County and surrounding areas. The center operates daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, providing shoppers with consistent access to a variety of retail and service offerings. With a strong 4.4-star rating based on over 1,386 reviews, The Commons at Holmdel has earned a reputation as a reliable and well-maintained shopping destination. Its strategic location along Route 35, a major commercial thoroughfare, ensures excellent visibility and accessibility for both local residents and passing traffic, making it an integral part of the Holmdel retail landscape.
